RFC7311-3-1.note: Judge 2026-09-30. TestRFC7311AIGPTLVLengthIsEleven: + WriteTo emits 01 000b and 8 value octets and ParseAIGP reads the metric back; - Type-1 TLVs of Length 12 and 10 are refused by ParseAIGP, the registered parser. Forbidden: accepting a Type-1 TLV whose Length is not 11. Records observed red (AIGPMetricOffset).

RFC7311-3-2.note: Judge 2026-09-30. TestRFC7311AIGPValueIsWholeTLVSet: + a value of two whole TLVs parses into exactly those two; - one, two or three trailing octets that do not form a TLV are refused. Forbidden: accepting a value that is not a whole set of TLVs.

RFC7311-3-3.note: Judge 2026-09-30. Reactor TestRFC7311OtherAIGPTLVsPassedAlongUnchanged drives a received [T1 100][T1 7][T9 abcd] through applyFactsAIGP, buildModifiedPayload and fwdBatchHandler to the socket, transparent and next-hop-self, under a policy replacement that drops the other TLVs (R1(b)); the octets after the first TLV reach the wire unchanged. Codec half TestRFC7311OtherAIGPTLVsSurviveTheCodec. Judge break: OpCopy of received[:11] on both rails turned both subtests red. Supersedes the earlier wrong verdict: the tags now prove the other-TLV passing, not first-TLV use.

RFC7311-3.2-4.note: Forbidden: keeping or passing along an AIGP whose transitive bit is set. TestRFC7606AIGPTransitiveIsDiscarded asserts Action==AttributeDiscard on code 26 with DiscardReasonMalformedValue and require.False(found) for AIGP after ApplyAttrDiscard, with ORIGIN, AS_PATH, NEXT_HOP intact; TestRFC7311AIGPTransitiveDiscardedOnReceive asserts the same through enforceRFC7606 with no error (discard, not reset). Positives with flags 0x80 assert RFC7606ActionNone and the AIGP bytes unchanged, so a codepoint-only check goes red.

RFC7311-3.2-5.note: Forbidden: acting on, or passing along, a malformed AIGP, or escalating beyond ignoring it. TestAIGPReceiveValidatesEveryTLV (IBGP, AIGP enabled) appends a truncated trailing TLV and asserts require.Equal(!malformed, present) on the payload leaving enforceRFC7606 (the bytes passed along), require.NoError (quietly, no session reset) and the NLRI kept (route not withdrawn). The well-formed half (unknown TLV plus duplicate metric) keeps the metric, so a blanket AIGP strip goes red.

RFC7311-3.2-6.note: Forbidden: judging an AIGP malformed for a repeated TLV type or an unknown TLV type. TestRFC7311DuplicateAndUnknownTLVsAreWellFormed parses two Type-1 TLVs and a Type-200 TLV with require.NoError, so rejecting either shape goes red; ParseAIGP and the receive validator validateAIGPAttr share AIGPMetricOffset. TestRFC7311MalformedVerdictIsForLengthOnly shows the malformed verdict exists (ErrMalformedValue on a Type-1 TLV of Length 8) and is lifted when only the length is repaired.

RFC7311-3.3-2.note: Forbidden: an EBGP (non-confederation) session defaulting AIGP_SESSION to enabled. TestAIGPSessionReceiveBoundary case external-default (peer AS 65002, local 65001, AIGPSession nil) asserts require.Equal(false, present) for AIGP after enforceRFC7606, which goes red on an enabled default; external-enabled shows the item is honoured when set; internal-default keeps AIGP, so the check is not a blanket strip.

RFC7311-3.4.3-2.note: RFC7311 Section 3.4.3: "In all the computations discussed in this section, the AIGP value MUST be capped at its maximum unsigned value 0xffffffffffffffff. Increasing the AIGP value MUST NOT cause the value to wrap around." All six tagged covers (three units) read. TestAIGPForwardedMetricsReachFinalWire requires exact final wire 100+30=130 and (max-5)+30=max. TestRFC7311DirectLinkCostNeverWrapsOrDisappears requires 100+7=107 and (max-5)+7=max. TestRFC7311RecursiveAIGPChangeReachesWire uses actual recursive Loc-RIB changes: initial 100+200+7=307; recursive max-5 overflows terminal addition; max-50 remains finite after terminal 7 but overflows source 100 addition; intervening and final recursive 400 yield exact 507. Finite and overflow controls isolate arithmetic, not malformed-attribute errors. Producers igpcost.Add/Resolve saturate recursive and terminal accumulation; applyFactsAIGP/replayAIGP saturate source addition. Consumer assertions inspect final UPDATE AIGP and distinguish finite recovery from reusing previously sent maximum. No new in-scope defect found. RFC7311-3.4.3-4.note: RFC7311 Section 3.4.3: "Suppose R1 changes the next hop of the route from R2 to R1. If R1's route to R2 is either (a) an IGP-learned route or (b) a static route that does not require recursive next hop resolution, then R1 MUST increase the value of the AIGP TLV by adding to A the distance from R1 to R2. This distance is either the IGP-computed distance from R1 to R2 or some value determined by policy. However, A MUST be increased by a non-zero amount." All six covers (three units) read. TestAIGPForwardedMetricsReachFinalWire requires final wire 130 from received 100 and distance 30 after next-hop-self; unchanged next hop retains 100 despite policy replacement, with direction/NLRI and source-immutability assertions. TestAIGPRecursiveDistanceUsesReceivedMetrics distinguishes received 100+200 from MED-like 9000/8000 and adds terminal interior 30 exactly once, yielding 330 and then 530. TestAIGPRecursiveStaticDistance ignores recursive static preference 9000, resolves terminal 30, rejects an unresolved chain and requires nonrecursive static distance 25. sysrib.IGPMetric delegates to igpcost.Resolve; its non-BGP nonrecursive branch returns terminal Metric; applyFactsAIGP consumes that distance. Resolver and wire adder are complementary separate tests, not a live IGP topology. No new in-scope defect found. Independent supplemental source rejudgment 2026-10-06. RFC7311-3.4.3-6.note: RFC 7311 Section 3.4.3, in the context of EBGP neighbors with a direct link running no IGP: 'Then, when R1 changes the next hop of a route from R2 to R1, the AIGP TLV value MUST be increased by a non-zero amount.' Re-read all four tagged units under internal/component/bgp/reactor/: rfc7311_processing_test.go::TestAIGPForwardedMetricsReachFinalWire, rfc7311_direct_link_test.go::TestRFC7311DirectLinkCostNeverWrapsOrDisappears, rfc7311_source_cost_test.go::TestRFC7311SourceLinkCostReachesRecipient and TestRFC7311UnknownCostWithdrawsUntilMetricRecovers. The first two directly call the arithmetic producer but now distinguish an exact withdrawal from an attribute-free announcement. The source-cost test closes their prior integration gap: a received UPDATE enters notifyMessageReceiver and the cache, then general ForwardUpdate or the live RS cached fallback through ForwardUpdatesDirect, finally reaching the worker/session socket. No IGP distance is available; source costs 7 and 19 deliberately differ from destination cost 43. The recipient must contain the same NLRI, no withdrawal, rewritten local NEXT_HOP, exact AIGP TLV/flags and metrics 107 or 119, with received source bytes unchanged. Transparent controls preserve metric 100, including unavailable cost, and boundary cases saturate rather than wrap as required by the surrounding paragraph. Unknown/resolved-zero controls on both rails require the exact withdrawn prefix with no announcement or attributes, both initially and after a prior metric-107 advertisement; supplying distance 11 restores the retained received metric as 111, without a new source UPDATE. These are substantive source-to-recipient assertions, not direct helper success or mere AIGP absence. Producing symbols: forward_aigp.go::sourceAIGPLinkMetric, aigpIncrement, applyFactsAIGP; reactor_api_forward.go::forwardUpdateSection and ForwardUpdate; forward_rs.go::sourceUsesCachedForward and reactorForwardRS (AIGP selects cached forwarding). Native panic records prove applyFactsAIGP reachability only, not arithmetic, source provenance or withdrawal semantics. The optional metric-comparability SHOULD is not silently promoted to this MUST row. No new checks, semantic mutation execution or interop pass is claimed.

RFC7311-3.4.3-7.note: RFC7311 Section 3.4.3: "The AIGP TLV value of a given route depends on (a) the AIGP TLV values of all the next hops that are recursively resolved during this procedure, and (b) the IGP distance to any next hop that is not recursively resolved. Any change due to (a) in any of these values MUST trigger a new AIGP computation for that route. Whether a change due to (b) triggers a new AIGP computation depends upon whether the change in IGP distance exceeds a configurable threshold." All twelve current covers (six units) read, including two cost-boundaries units missing from the old four-unit audit map. TestRFC7311RecursiveAIGPChangeReachesWire supplies automatic trigger proof: after one received UPDATE it changes actual recursive Loc-RIB AIGP while runAIGPAdvertisements runs, waits for worker completion and requires wire 307,max,507,max,507. TestAIGPReadvertisesFromReceivedGeneration checks cache eviction, exactly two frames and 107 to 111 after interior distance change. TestAIGPRecursiveDistanceUsesReceivedMetrics tests deeper recursive 330 to 530, unchanged 330, missing AIGP and saturation. TestAIGPDistanceChangeReselectsRetainedRoutes explicitly reselects and requires changed Loc-RIB winner while preserving received AIGP 10. TestRFC7311RecursiveZeroCostRemainsAnnounced manually replays recursive 7 to 0 and requires announced AIGP 100, not withdrawal. TestRFC7311ExtendedNextHopCostRecovery manually replays after distance 11 becomes available and requires exact restored IPv4 MP_REACH with IPv6 self next hop and AIGP 111 for both 16/32-byte received forms. Manual replay/reselection carriers are supplementary, not credited as automatic-trigger proof. Production Loc-RIB equality includes AIGP/presence; changes increment revision and notify subscribers; runAIGPAdvertisements scans and replayAIGP recomputes from retained received bytes, dispatching normal forwarding to fwdBatchHandler and successful-flush receipt update. The mandatory recursive clause is enforced; no configurable clause-(b) threshold feature is claimed. No new in-scope defect found. Independent supplemental source rejudgment 2026-10-06.
